prompt:
Create ONE key sheet for the human of a silent animated film, shot s01. Use case: illustration-story. This is plate B of two (keys K5 to K8, beat 2: the pop, joy, and the fold). Pure black sheet, two rows, 16:9.
REFERENCE ROLES. Image 1 is the approved MODEL SHEET of the human: keep this exact character (green skin, mauve-and-blue angular poncho, one trailing swoop of cream-and-mauve hair, large hands, flared trousers and boots), the same proportions (about eight heads tall, long thin limbs), the same flat colours with identity pigments, and the same thin pale contour (about one 166th of the figure's height). Image 2 is the approved pick: its line quality, tapered tips and stipple shadow. Image 3 is the cinematography sheet of the shot: use it only for ROW 2 (camera, the plain box, the blue light, the hue pair #0a51fb and #fad204).
ROW 1 (upper 70 percent of the sheet): 4 full-length figures of the SAME human, left to right, numbered K5, K6, K7, K8 in cream numerals under each, each figure FULL LENGTH with both boots visible, all drawn at exactly the same scale (every standing figure the same height, about 62 percent of the sheet height) on one shared baseline, flat shapes, pale contour, stipple shadow, no gradients, no box and no props in row 1 (draw the hands where the invisible lid would be), each pose with one clear line of action and a silhouette that reads when filled black. Keep the head, the hair swoop, the poncho and the trousers identical in design to the model sheet.
POSES:
K5 (brace, frame 154): hands drawn in to the chest, shoulders up, weight leaning back on the heels, eyes fixed up on the swelling bubble. Line of action: a backward lean from heels to crown, hands as the fulcrum.
K6 (joy-a, frame 190): arms flung up and out, back arched, hips pushed to the left, face up: the burst after the pop. Line of action: one big diagonal from the right foot up through the left hand.
K7 (joy-b, frame 228): the same joy turned the other way: hips to the right, arms swapped, the hair swoop swinging across (the turn). Line of action: the diagonal reverses, an S-curve through the torso.
K8 (shrink, frame 272): knees bent, back rounded, chin to chest, forearms crossed over the head: small and covering. Line of action: a closing C from the crown down to the bent knees.
ROW 2 (lower 30 percent): the same 4 keys as small 16:9 frame thumbnails numbered F5, F6, F7, F8 under them, each at the shot's camera: the widened camera: the human small at the bottom centre of a vast black field flooded with Turrell blue light from a huge machine above, pieces all around, the lid of the box open beside her; F5 is still the medium-wide camera as the bubble swells, F6 to F8 are the wide camera. The human at the size the cinematography sheet draws her, one emitter in blue, black field. These thumbnails are staging proof only.
No other text. Do not add background scenery to row 1.
